claims.text: The FDA label says a single large alcohol dose, 3 mL/kg of whiskey, decreases theophylline clearance for up to 24 hours.
claims.quote: A single large dose of alcohol (3 mL/kg of whiskey) decreases theophylline clearance for up to 24 hours.

headline.text: The FDA label says a single large alcohol dose decreases theophylline clearance for up to 24 hours.

reported.text: The label specifies a dose of 3 mL/kg of whiskey.

mechanism.text: The interaction described in the label is reduced theophylline clearance.
